scope: Hawaiian governance transitions. Separate from frozen first batch. No geometry or legal-status adjudication.

archives.locator: Explanatory narrative: 1810 unification; January 17, 1893 overthrow; 1894 Republic; July 7, 1898 resolution. Transcript includes Liliuokalani December 19, 1898 protest.
archives.caveat: Distinguish the date the US resolution passed from subsequent formal transfer and territorial organization. Several compressed explanatory statements need additional specialist checking; only listed claims adopted.

palace.locator: Opening two paragraphs on accession, provisional government and 1895 restoration attempt/imprisonment.

events.text: Kamehameha unified the islands under one kingdom.
events.caveat: Unification is not automatically the first founding of his kingdom; earlier political phases remain to research.

events.text: The Committee of Safety overthrew Queen Liliuokalani with support from the US minister and US forces; it proclaimed a Provisional Government.
events.caveat: Use an overthrow of government label. This is not a finding that Hawaiian people or culture ended.

events.text: The Provisional Government proclaimed the Republic of Hawaii.
After an unsuccessful royalist restoration attempt, the Queen was imprisoned and compelled to relinquish claims to the throne.
The US Congress adopted an annexation resolution. Hawaiian opposition and the Queen's protests form part of the source record.
